outcome: Vertical or horizontal transmission of SARS-CoV-2
cohort: 769 pregnant women at Hospital Universitario 12 de Octubre, Madrid, Spain, during weeks 10 to 19 of 2020
finding: Seroprevalence of SARS-CoV-2 in pregnant women in southern Madrid increased to 21.4% during the study period, with a significant increase in preterm birth rate in the group with symptomatic COVID-19 confirmed by RT-PCR.
mod_finding: Cesarean/operative delivery rate was higher in the group with symptomatic COVID-19 confirmed by RT-PCR (50% vs 26.9% in the seronegative group).
